meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides YouTube Music promos, Premium nags and sign-in cards; toggles for shelves, chips, cover art, the player panel and more
meta.notes:
**Live check (2026-11-17).** Opened `https://music.youtube.com/` logged out in a desktop-UA browser at 1440×900 and read the DOM 9 seconds after load, including the Polymer shadow children. `recipes/fixtures/youtube-music/desktop-live-home.html` is a trimmed reconstruction of that structure (not a verbatim capture).

Seen live and used: `ytmusic-guide-signin-promo-renderer` 1, `ytmusic-tastebuilder-shelf-renderer` 1, `ytmusic-chip-cloud-renderer` (Relax, Sleep, Sad, Romance... 10 chips), `ytmusic-carousel-shelf-renderer` 3, `ytmusic-thumbnail-renderer`, `ytmusic-inline-badge-renderer` (Explicit), `ytmusic-content-update-chip`, `ytmusic-av-toggle`, `ytmusic-player-page #side-panel`, `ytmusic-like-button-renderer`, `ytmusic-playback-rate-renderer`, `ytmusic-guide-renderer` and `ytmusic-search-box #suggestion-list`.

**Not verified:** the original `ytmusic-mealbar-promo-renderer`, `ytmusic-statement-banner-renderer`, `ytmusic-upsell-dialog-renderer` and `SPunlimited` Upgrade tab (they appear only signed in or after a trigger; they stay in the synthetic fixtures), the narrow-layout `ytmusic-pivot-bar-item-renderer[tab-id="FEmusic_explore"]` Explore tab (not rendered at 1440px), the mobile layout, signed-in pages, the cookie dialog (none was shown) and what a Dim or Blur looks like on every page.

The recipe covers `music.youtube.com` only; the YouTube recipe covers `www.youtube.com` and `m.youtube.com`. Ads inside playback are not touched: CSS cannot remove them.

- Promo banners, the Premium upsell, the sidebar sign-in card, the taste-builder card, the refresh chip and cookie banners are on by default.
- Everything else (Upgrade and Explore tabs, chips, shelves, cover art, Explicit badges, Song/Video switch, side panel, like and speed buttons, sidebar, search suggestions) is off by default: you may want it.
